repo_meta_data.description: Install Tiledesk on your server using Helm for Kubernetes orchestration and Docker Compose for running multi-container Docker applications. Tiledesk provides an open-source solution comparable to Voiceflow, empowering you to create sophisticated LLM-enabled chatbots that seamlessly transition interactions to human agents when needed.
